objective: Put the property and mutation gates on the merge and release decision path instead of leaving them to a weekly schedule.
decision_supported: Does a gate that runs on a schedule gate anything? No: nothing on the merge path consults it, so a regression can land and only show up days later.
acceptance: make check includes property-gate and mutation-gate.
ci.yml runs both gates in the required foundation-checks job.
The scheduled workflow still exists for its own cadence.
evidence: make -n check output naming both targets
stop_conditions: The gates would exceed the job timeout.
risks_and_fallbacks: Adding them to foundation-checks lengthens every PR run; they are seeded and bounded.
Fallback: keep them scheduled and revert the ci.yml step only.
